description: Search FDIC-insured bank failures and assistance transactions since 1934 by name, CERT, headquarters state, failure date range, resolution method, or size. Returns each event with failure date, acquirer, total assets and deposits, and the FDIC's estimated loss to the insurance fund, plus totals over every matching event; group_by adds counts and losses per year, state, method, or fund. Searches failures only unless resolution is set to assistance or all. Dollar amounts are in thousands.

certs.description: Up to 50 CERTs of failed institutions. Events before 1977 carry no CERT.

from_date.description: Earliest failure date to include (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2023-03-10).

group_by.description: Add counts, assets, deposits, and estimated losses per year, state, method, or insurance_fund over every matching event.

methods.description: How each event was resolved: PA purchase and assumption of all deposits, PI P&A of insured deposits only, P&A P&A with deposit scope undetermined, IDT insured deposit transfer, ABT asset-backed transfer, PO payout, DINB payout through a Deposit Insurance National Bank, A/A assistance transaction, REP reprivatization, MGR FSLIC management takeover, OBAM undocumented assistance code.

items.description: Resolution method code, uppercase; fdic_list_reference topic failure_methods lists them.

min_assets.description: Minimum total assets at the last report before failure, in thousands of US dollars.

name.description: Failed institution name, up to 100 characters; every word of two or more letters or digits must appear in the name FDIC recorded (e.g. "silicon valley"). Case-insensitive. A standalone NA is ignored beside other words, so it also finds names recorded with N.A.

offset.description: Events to skip (0–100,000); pass next_offset from the previous page.

resolution.description: failure (default), assistance (open-bank assistance and similar transactions), or all. Echoed as resolution_filter.

sort.description: date_desc (newest first, default), date_asc, loss_desc (largest estimated loss first), or assets_desc.

state.description: Failed institution's headquarters state: two-letter code in any case or full name.

name: fdic_search_failures

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the failures index (ISO timestamp).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: state is not a US state, DC, or territory code or name. `invalid_name`: name has no word of two or more letters or digits. `invalid_date`: from_date or to_date names a day its month does not have. `invalid_date_range`: from_date is after to_date. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: One failure or assistance event; an optional field is absent when FDIC recorded no value for it.

acquirer.description: Acquiring institution; absent for payouts and assistance without one.

cert.description: CERT of the failed institution; absent before 1977.

charter_class.description: Charter class code of the failed institution — a bank_classes code (fdic_list_reference topic bank_classes), or MI on a few savings-bank records from before 1984.

estimated_loss.description: FDIC estimated loss to the insurance fund, USD thousands; absent when FDIC has no estimate (0 is a real value).

estimated_loss_as_of.description: Date of the most recent loss estimate (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when FDIC recorded none.

fin.description: FDIC financial institution number, when recorded.

insurance_fund.description: Fund that bore the cost: DIF, BIF, SAIF, RTC, FSLIC, or FDIC.

method.description: Resolution method code, e.g. PA, PO, A/A; fdic_list_reference topic failure_methods lists the codes.

name.description: Failed institution name as FDIC recorded it.

resolved_on.description: Resolution date (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when FDIC recorded none.

total_assets.description: Total assets at the last report before failure, USD thousands; absent when not recorded.

total_deposits.description: Total deposits at the last report before failure, USD thousands; absent when not recorded.

groups.description: Present with group_by. Years run ascending with empty years filled in; other keys by count, largest first.

estimated_loss_missing_count.description: Events without an FDIC loss estimate — estimated_loss_total covers only the rest.

estimated_loss_total.description: Sum of FDIC estimated losses over events that have an estimate, USD thousands; null when none of them has one.

key.description: Year, state code, method code, or fund.

total_assets.description: Sum of total assets at the last report before failure, USD thousands; events with no recorded figure add nothing.

total_deposits.description: Sum of total deposits, USD thousands.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; present when more events remain.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the page is past the end, or more pages remain.

summary.description: Totals over every matching event, not just this page.

by_method.description: Totals per resolution method, largest count first.

estimated_loss_missing_count.description: Events without an FDIC loss estimate — estimated_loss_total covers only the rest.

estimated_loss_total.description: Sum of FDIC estimated losses over events that have an estimate, USD thousands; null when none of them has one.

total_assets.description: Sum of total assets at the last report before failure, USD thousands; events with no recorded figure add nothing.

estimated_loss_missing_count.description: Events without an FDIC loss estimate — estimated_loss_total covers only the rest.

estimated_loss_total.description: Sum of FDIC estimated losses over events that have an estimate, USD thousands; null when none of them has one.

total_assets.description: Sum of total assets at the last report before failure, USD thousands; events with no recorded figure add nothing.

total_deposits.description: Sum of total deposits, USD thousands.

truncated.description: True when more events remain beyond this page.

title: Search FDIC bank failures
